core_problem_solved: To provide a comprehensive set of data structures and algorithms for high-performance scientific and technical computing in Java, addressing the language's native lack of efficient, specialized numerical processing capabilities.
key_features: Linear algebra routines (matrix operations, decompositions, etc.)
Advanced statistical tools and probability distributions
High-performance collections for primitive types (e.g., int, double)
era_and_niche: Developed at CERN, it was a key library for scientific research and large-scale data analysis performed in Java, particularly within academic and research environments throughout the 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: Its mindshare has declined as the scientific computing community at large has heavily shifted towards Python with its dominant NumPy and SciPy ecosystem. Within the JVM world, more general-purpose libraries like Apache Commons Math or specialized ones like ND4J (for deep learning) have become more common for new projects.
